profile.headline: SQL Database Developer/SSIS / ETL Developer
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer / Data Engineer/SQL Database Developer
profile.summary:
•	15+ years of experience in IT, Database design and development 
•	Hands-on experience in T-SQL Programming, SQL (DDL, DML), and Transact-SQL, PL/SQL
•	In-depth knowledge of relational database (RDBMS) development and client/server technology 
•	 Advanced experience of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) in all phases: 
 Analysis, Design, Technical Specification, Coding and Unit Testing
•	 Highly disciplined and self-motivated, accomplish objectives and work well without direction

Specialties: Microsoft .NET: C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, ADO.NET
Languages: Perl, C++,C#, VB, ANSI, SQL, T-SQL
Databases: SQL Server 2000, SQL Server 2005, SQL Server 2008, Integration Services (SSIS)
BI: Analysis Services (SSAS)
